pages.title: Emberstar Game
pages.text: The Emberstar Game is a memory game. The NPC serves as a buffer in between selections. All lights are used in a single round.

pages.title: Unpowered Emberstar
pages.text: An Unpowered Emberstar is required to boot up the core and start the game.

pages.title: Electrified Quartz
pages.text: Electrified Quartz is used to charge the blocks you are selecting, consuming it in the process. Bring plenty!

pages.title: Eternal Emberstar Generator
pages.text: An Eternal Emberstar Generator is given for succesfully completing the game.
